DFMA Review · S5 · mock-up of a screen change (D-023, proposed) · 8 Nov 2026

Passed checks and selectable setups

You asked for two things. First, the features with no finding, with the checks each passed, why, and the math, collapsed by default. Second, each setup in the Machine plan selectable to show its features with a brief why. The pictures are screenshots of the built screen on the real test parts (LESSONS "ui").

Your call

Approve, Change (say what), or Rethink.

Each rule's passed check is its finding test turned round, in the same file, with the same numbers and limit (passes() next to check()). A test runs every test part through every rule and holds that each feature is either flagged or passed, never both and never neither (tests/service/test_passed.py).

What I chose, and the alternatives

  • The Passed list sits under the findings, in the Findings panel, not in the legend. D-012 already kept a "Rules passed" list for later; this is that list.
  • A feature with any finding is not in Passed. Its finding shows what failed. Showing its passed checks too is a small change if you want it.
  • Walls are in Passed too (9 on this part), and they come last: the EDMR part nasty_cheese lists 353 passed features, 321 of them walls (measured in this session).
  • States: no part, or an error: no Passed group and no plan. Turning: no plan until S6.
